name: Ploid
description: People search and enrichment over 2B+ people: find people by role or company, resolve identities, and get work emails and phones via REST API, CLI or hosted MCP.

skills.name: Find People
skills.description: Searches an index of more than two billion people by role, company, location or experience, ranked by evidence.

skills.name: Resolve a Person
skills.description: Identifies one person from a full name plus a clue such as company, email or phone and returns a permanent person ID.

skills.name: Find Emails and Phones
skills.description: Finds work emails, personal emails and phone numbers for a known person through the enrich endpoint.

skills.name: Enrich Lists
skills.description: Fills typed columns like headcount, socials or work email for rows you supply, each answer with confidence and evidence.

skills.name: Monitor People Changes
skills.description: Watches people or lists and notifies you through webhooks when something changes.
